# Forbes

> > Forbes is a global media company providing business news, financial insights, and tools for brands to engage with premium audiences through advertising and recognition programs.

Forbes offers self-service advertising solutions through Forbes Ad Manager, enabling brands to reach high-value business audiences. The platform also provides accolade products and awards for companies seeking professional recognition.

## Key Topics

- Forbes Ad Manager
- Digital Advertising
- Self-Service Platform
- Campaign Management
- Audience Targeting
- Business Advertising
- Company Awards
- Professional Recognition
- Forbes Accolades
- Brand Marketing
- Premium Audiences

## Advertising & Marketing

- [Forbes Ad Manager](https://admanager.forbes.com/): Self-service advertising platform for brands to reach Forbes audiences

## Optional

- [Forbes Accolade Store](https://accoladesproducts.forbes.com/): Store for purchasing Forbes awards and recognition products
